details: Bitcoin broke above $81,000 on September 18, marking its third consecutive day of gains. This rally occurred despite the U.S. Senate's recent rejection of the crypto-friendly Clarity Act and the Federal Reserve's interest rate hike. The market showed resilience, with significant liquidation of short positions as prices surged. U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs also recorded a net inflow of approximately $160 million on September 17, reversing earlier outflows and indicating renewed institutional interest.
title: Bitcoin Surges Past $81,000 Amid Fed & Regulatory Setbacks

details: On September 17, the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) issued a temporary five-year Innovation Exemption. This allows qualifying blockchain trading venues to list and trade tokenized U.S. stocks via automated market makers and liquidity pools without full registration as exchanges. This development creates a direct regulatory pathway for on-chain trading of tokenized equities and is seen as a significant boost for real-world asset (RWA) tokenization protocols.
title: SEC Grants Innovation Exemption for Tokenized Securities Trading

details: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) submitted a prerule on crypto asset transactions and markets to the White House for review on September 17. This move signals the CFTC's intent to establish a framework for crypto derivatives using its existing authority, following the U.S. Senate's failure to advance the comprehensive Clarity Act. While the specific provisions are not yet public, this step could reshape how exchanges offer leveraged trading for digital assets.
title: CFTC Advances Crypto Rulemaking After Clarity Act Fails

details: Grayscale's Zcash ETF (ZCSH) is preparing a 3-for-1 forward share split, set to be effective before trading begins on September 30. This adjustment aims to lower the ETF's per-share price, potentially enhancing its accessibility for a broader range of investors through traditional brokerage accounts. The ZCSH fund has seen substantial growth, with net assets approaching $890 million since its launch.
title: Grayscale Zcash ETF Announces 3-for-1 Share Split

details: Investor Kevin O'Leary announced he is actively acquiring new crypto positions for the upcoming market cycle. He emphasized that a major stock exchange's adoption of blockchain technology would represent a "watershed moment" for the industry. O'Leary believes the next phase of crypto investing will focus on identifying which blockchains gain widespread adoption across various traditional sectors.
title: Kevin O'Leary Resumes Crypto Investments, Highlights Exchange Blockchain Adoption

details: Coinbase has filed with the Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) to introduce single-stock perpetual futures in the United States. This initiative aims to bring a crypto-native derivatives product, which offers 24/5 exposure to individual stocks like Apple and Microsoft without requiring direct ownership of the underlying shares, to the U.S. market.
title: Coinbase Seeks Approval for Single-Stock Perpetual Futures in US
